summary: Prevent Next dev from automatically rewriting canonical Git-maintained AGENTS instructions
evidence: Actual Next16.3.4 startup added nextjs-agent-rules to tracked AGENTS.md; setting supported agentRules:false stopped re-addition on restart
Canonical AGENTS.md restored exactly after only the observed generated block was removed
rollback: Revert only agentRules setting if framework-generated instructions become explicitly desired; never overwrite canonical AGENTS content
